headline: Phase 3 relapse reductions of 35% and 31% with no comparator stated; no reaction at a $289B company
reasoning: Source: Novartis's release (Benzinga 16:44 UTC): 'Novartis Announces Remibrutinib Lowers Annualized Relapse Rate By 35.2%, 31.2% In Phase III REMODEL-1, REMODEL-2 Studies To Treat Relapsing Multiple Sclerosis'. No body text; the comparator arm is not in our sources.

Without the comparator, the size cannot be judged: a 31-35% relative cut against an active oral drug is modest next to existing high-efficacy MS therapies, while against placebo it would be weak. Either way it is not an obvious win, and MS is one market among many for a $289B company.
Price: NVS +0.1% since the item (151.195 to 151.39). It is -3.1% on the day from 156.265, but that move came before this release.
objections: Comparator not disclosed; effect size ambiguous; immaterial at Novartis's size; no reaction.
